source: Création d'une interface de lobby stylisée 'Battle Royale' (type Fortnite).\n​Ajoute une pop-up d'avertissement non bloquante au démarrage qui s'affiche proprement et disparaît après validation, rappelant de configurer l'avatar en R15.\n​Ajoute un bouton de menu simple permettant de basculer l'ambiance visuelle entre un mode 'Classique' et un mode 'Rendu épuré' pour la map, sans surcharger la console d'erreurs.

image_prompt.text: A stylized lobby plaza where the whole server gathers, sized so nobody bottlenecks at the exits, dressed in the bright angular look of a battle-royale hub

notes: Battle Royale here is a style reference for the lobby, not a request for a battle royale map. No match arena was asked for, so Shooter was not loaded and no match stage was built.
No preset was taken. Minigame drags in an isolated stage and P4 the prompt never asked for, and Childhood Game brings hide-and-seek clutter that is actively wrong.
The map must support two switchable visual ambiances, Classic and Clean Render. That is a whole-build constraint on how the lobby is dressed and lit, and nothing in the handoff owns it.
Almost everything else in this prompt is UI and scripting: a startup popup, a menu button, and a clean error console.

open_questions.ask: Is the lobby the whole game, or does it feed into a battle royale match map we should build too?
How many players should the lobby hold at once?

theme: Stylized battle-royale hub - bright, clean, angular

coverage_missing.ask: Does the lobby lead into a match map, or is the lobby the entire build?
Is this a 3D lobby space, or literally a 2D menu screen? Interface could mean either.

answers.ask: Is the lobby the whole game, or does it feed into a battle royale match map we should build too?
answers.answer: Le périmètre demandé est uniquement le lobby et son interface stylisée ; ne construisez pas de map de match Battle Royale pour cette première version.

answers.ask: How many players should the lobby hold at once?
answers.answer: Prévoyez un petit lobby pouvant accueillir jusqu’à 10 joueurs simultanément.
